{{- /* One inline SVG icon by name: "search", "warning" or "check". Decorative only (aria-hidden): the text next to it carries the meaning. It strokes in currentColor, so its colour comes from a CSS class on the element around it, never from a colour value here (SPEC section 7). */ -}} {{- $paths := dict "search" `` "warning" `` "check" `` -}} {{- with index $paths . -}} {{- else -}} {{- errorf "icon.html: unknown icon %q" . -}} {{- end -}}
